data.description: Protocol Amendment (e) incorporating regulatory feedback. Changes include replacement of 'mucosal healing' with 'histologic-endoscopic mucosal improvement plus absence of neutrophils', updates to Schedule of Activities, addition of gallbladder disease risk assessment for tirzepatide, updates to inclusion/exclusion criteria including addition of ECG exclusion criterion, updates to continued access section, correction of FDA guidance year in mMS section, and update to mMS appendix per FDA Guidance 2016. Electronically Signed and Approved by Lilly on 04 Nov 2025 GMT. Document ID: VV-CLIN-168867.

Original Protocol, approved 04-Feb-2025. Protocol Number: I6T-MC-AMCD. Study: COMMIT-UC. Phase 3b study of mirikizumab (LY3074828) and tirzepatide (LY3298176) in adult participants with moderately to severely active ulcerative colitis and obesity or overweight. IND: 174802; EU trial number: 2024-520209-38-00.
